prompt_head:
Role: Staff Software Engineer, AI Engineering at Tebra
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 8+ years of professional software engineering experience

assessments.note: Python experience present, but no Java/Spring Boot evidence.
AI-enabled apps shipped with >2 years experience.
Orchestration experience shown, but not specific frameworks.
Distributed systems background present, no Kafka experience.
AI guardrails mentioned, lacking explicit observability details.
Cloudflare Workers used, but no AWS/Azure/GCP listed.
Mentoring indicates communication, but cross-functional examples missing.
No healthcare or regulated domain experience.
Context methodology hints at knowledge graph, no vector DB.
No PyTorch or Hugging Face exposure.
Founded and led AI platform development.

output.verdict_line: Candidate shows solid AI and full‑stack experience but lacks the required seniority, Java/Spring expertise, and Kafka‑based distributed systems background.
top_gaps: Kafka or similar messaging platform experience (r5)
